propositions: Op-cert service performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookup and patches process-global state, coupling app config to one secret store and creating concurrency/cleanup hazards.

Startup must accept exactly one source (REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY), validate before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, copy to process-owned 0700 dir/0600 file, and never re-read.

Both signing producer chains (completion via sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via generation.sign_manifest) must thread an immutable context-local OpcertSigner binding through to mint_opcert_record instead of reading os.environ.

Op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; the key must be materialized before start by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file and bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must prove context-local signer/principal/push isolation with one immutable startup signer and no workspace push remote.
Secret/key material must be absent from repr, serialization, argv, logs, exceptions, output, fingerprints, provenance, and persisted envelopes beyond existing public signature.
